def solve(g):
    bgc=g[0][0]
    pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(len(g)) for cc in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][cc]!=bgc]
    mr=min(r for r,_ in pts); Mc=max(cc for _,cc in pts)
    Mm=max(r for r,_ in pts); mm=min(cc for _,cc in pts)
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for cc in range(mm,Mc+1):
        if g[mr][cc]!=bgc: continue
        o[mr][cc]=2
        if g[Mm][cc]!=bgc: continue
        o[Mm][cc]=2
    for r in range(mr,Mm+1):
        if g[r][mm]!=bgc: continue
        o[r][mm]=2
        if g[r][Mc]!=bgc: continue
        o[r][Mc]=2
    return o
print(solve(I)==O)

def solve(g):

    mm=min(cc for _,cc in pts); Mc=max(cc for _,cc in pts)
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for cc in range(mm,Mc+1):
        o[mr][cc]=2
        o[Mm][cc]=2
    for r in range(mr,Mm+1):
        o[r][mm]=2
        o[r][Mc]=2
    return o

def combine(g):
    bgc=g[0][0]
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(len(g)) for cc in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][cc]!=bgc]
    mr=min(r for r,_ in pts); Mm=max(r for r,_ in pts)
    mm=min(cc for _,cc in pts); Mc=max(cc for _,cc in pts)
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for cc in range(mm,Mc+1):
        if o[mr][cc]==bgc: o[mr][cc]=2
        if o[Mm][cc]==bgc: o[Mm][cc]=2
    for r in range(mr,Mm+1):
        if o[r][mm]==bgc: o[r][mm]=2
        if o[r][Mc]==bgc: o[r][Mc]=2
    return o
print(combine(I)==O)

from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull
def solve(g, fill=2):
    bgc=g[0][0]
    pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(len(g)) for cc in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][cc]!=bgc]
    p=[list(x) for x in pts]; ptsset=set(pts)
    H=ConvexHull(p); order=H.vertices
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(len(order)):
        a,b=p[order[i]],p[order[(i+1)%len(order)]]
        r1,c1,r2,c2=a[0],a[1],b[0],b[1]
        steps=max(abs(r2-r1),abs(c2-c1))
        dr=(r2-r1)/steps; dc=(c2-c1)/steps
        for k in range(steps):
            rr,cc2=int(r1+k*dr),int(c1+k*dc)
            if (rr,cc2)!=(a or b):
                if o[rr][cc2]==bgc: o[rr][cc2]=fill
    return o
print(solve(I)==O, solve(I2)==O2)

from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull
def solve(g, fill=2):
    bgc=g[0][0]
    pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(len(g)) for cc in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][cc]!=bgc]
    H=ConvexHull(pts); order=H.vertices
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    n=len(order)
    for i in range(n):
        a,b=pts[order[i]],pts[order[(i+1)%n]]
        for t in [0.01,0.5,0.99]:
            rr,cc=int(a[0]+t*(b[0]-a[0])),int(a[1]+t*(b[1]-a[1]))
            if o[rr][cc]==bgc: o[rr][cc]=fill
    return o
print(solve(I)==O, solve(I2)==O2)

from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull
def solve(g, fill=2):
    bgc=g[0][0]
    pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(len(g)) for cc in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][cc]!=bgc]
    H=ConvexHull(pts); order=list(H.vertices)
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(len(order)):
        a,b=pts[order[i]],pts[order[(i+1)%len(order)]]
        steps=max(abs(a[0]-b[0]),abs(a[1]-b[1])) or 1
        dr=(a[0]-b[0])/steps; dc=(a[1]-b[1])/steps
        rr,cc=a[0]+dr,b[1]*0  # placeholder
    # rebuild: walk hull boundary pixel by pixel
    for i in range(len(order)):
        a,b=pts[order[i]],pts[order[(i+1)%len(order)]]
        steps=max(abs(a[0]-b[0]),abs(a[1]-b[1])); steps=max(steps,1)
        for t in range(int(steps)+1):
            rr=int(a[0]+t*(b[0]-a[0])/steps); cc=int(a[1]+t*(b[1]-a[1])/steps)
            if 0<=rr<len(g) and 0<=cc<len(g[0]) and g[rr][cc]==bgc: o[rr][cc]=fill
    return o

        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                if out[r][c]==bgc: out[r][c]=2
    return out

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    pts={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=g[0][0]}
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if out[r0][c]==g[0][0]: out[r0][c]=2
        if out[r1][c]==g[0][0]: out[r1][c]=2
        if out[r][c]==g[0][0]: pass
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        if out[r][c0]==g[0][0]: out[r][c0]=2
        if out[r][c1]==g[0][0]: out[r][c1]=2
    return out
print('d1:',solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print('d2:',solve(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
import json
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    o=solve(G[k+' input']); print('OK' if o==G[k+' output'] else 'MISMATCH')
T=solve(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(T))

```python
def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]; bg=g[0][0]
    pts={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg}
    r0,r1=min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0,c1=min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    def inbbox(p): return r0<=p[0]<=r1 and c0<=p[1]<=c1
    # extend each marker along its row and col until marker, bbox edge, or grid edge; paint 2
    res=set()
    for r,c in pts:
        for dr,dc in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and inbbox((rr,cc)):
                if (rr,cc) in pts: break
                res.add((rr,cc))
                rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    for p in res:
        if out[p[0]][p[1]]==bg: out[p[0]][p[1]]=2
    return out
```
